Message.Name: System Event Message
Message.Description: The system event message type is used to signal a market or data feed handler event.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight.

Field.Name: Event Code
Field.Description: Refer to System Event Codes below

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Directory Message
Message.Description: A Complex Order Strategy Message containing the strategy definition will be sent whenever a complex order is added in the system for an underlying.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal System Tracking Number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: Nanoseconds since midnight

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Option ID assigned daily. Valid for trading day

Field.Name: Strategy Type
Field.Description: Strategy Type

Field.Name: Underlying Symbol
Field.Description: Underlying Symbol for the strategy. All legs in this strategy belong to this Underlying

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Field.Name: Number of legs
Field.Description: Number of legs in the strategy Legs NOTE: Leg field offsets below are an equation, where "n" is the zero based leg number (0, 1, ...)

Field.Name: Leg Information
Field.Description: Leg Information

Message.Name: Strategy Trading Action Message
Message.Description: The options system uses this administrative message to indicate the current trading status of an index or equity option within the options market.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal System Tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the Strategy, as defined in the Complex Strategy Message.

Field.Name: Current Trading State
Field.Description: Current Trading State

Message.Name: Complex Strategy Trade Report
Message.Description: The Complex Strategy Trade Report message is used to publish real-time trade information for complex strategies.

Field.Name: Tracking Number
Field.Description: Internal system tracking number

Field.Name: Timestamp
Field.Description: The time, expressed as the number of nanoseconds after midnight.

Field.Name: Strategy ID
Field.Description: Integer ID of the option, as defined in the Complex Strategy Directory Message.

Field.Name: Cross ID
Field.Description: Indicates the internal control number (cross id) associated with the given options trade transaction.

Field.Name: Trade Condition
Field.Description: The Trade Condition is the same as defined in the OPRA specification.

Field.Name: Price
Field.Description: Reflects the transaction (premium) price on the execution.

Field.Name: Volume
Field.Description: Current number of contracts traded for an option in one trade.

Field.Name: Reserved
Field.Description: Reserved for future use.

Message.Name: End of Replay Sequence Message
Message.Description: The End of replay Sequence message reflects the sequence number at the time replay of existing messages is complete.

Field.Name: End of Replay Sequence Number
Field.Description: Sequence number once the replay is complete.

Field.Name: Option ID
Field.Description: Option ID for this leg, valid for the trading day.

Field.Name: Security Symbol
Field.Description: Denotes the option root symbol (security symbol)

Field.Name: Expiration Year
Field.Description: Last two digits of the year of the option expiration

Field.Name: Expiration Month
Field.Description: Expiration Month of the option (1-12)

Field.Name: Expiration Day
Field.Description: Day of the Month of expiration (1-31)

Field.Name: Explicit Strike Price
Field.Description: Explicit strike price. Refer to Data Types for field processing notes. Zero (0) for Stock Leg.

Field.Name: Option Type
Field.Description: Option Type

Field.Name: Side
Field.Description: Indicates the side of the leg

Field.Name: Leg Ratio
Field.Description: Leg Ratio
